tools.name: GitHub
tools.role: Versioned Project FAR state, governance, source, evidence, reviews, issues, commits, branches, releases, and audit history.
prohibited: treating CI or merge status as mathematical proof
tools.independence_rule: Repository state supplies the target and record; repository authorship does not establish independent review.

tools.name: Lean
tools.role: Machine-check derivations relative to encoded types, definitions, premises, logic, and toolchain.
prohibited: claiming the encoding matches prose without an alignment audit
treating a build as unrestricted proof
tools.independence_rule: A separate alignment review is required; machine checking is not evaluator independence.
contamination_controls: map declarations to exact source hashes

tools.name: Wolfram
tools.role: Symbolic, numeric, finite, and computational checking or counterexample search.
tools.independence_rule: Tool output corroborates or threatens a claim but is not an independent proof review by itself.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.role: Discover and triage scholarly evidence and candidate prior art.
tools.independence_rule: Independent sources may be discovered; Project FAR's mapping and interpretation remain non-independent unless separately reviewed.

tools.name: SciSpace
tools.role: Discover, inspect, and navigate scholarly literature.
tools.independence_rule: Discovery platform agreement does not create source independence or correctness.

tools.name: Scite
tools.role: Discover citation contexts and supporting, disputing, or mentioning relationships for literature triage.
tools.independence_rule: Platform classification must be checked against the cited source and exact FAR claim.

tools.name: Zotero
tools.role: Manage bibliographic identity, stable citation keys, metadata, collections, attachments, and exports.
prohibited: changing theorem, review, novelty, or governance status
tools.independence_rule: Bibliographic correctness is separate from evidential relevance and truth.

tools.name: Acumen/Talarion
tools.role: Research discovery, evidence organization, and candidate prior-art analysis where available.
prohibited: canonical Project FAR edits outside GitHub
tools.independence_rule: Tool-produced synthesis is model-assisted evidence and must disclose authorship/exposure.

tools.name: Ordinary web research
tools.role: Discover public primary sources, documentation, standards, and current external facts.
tools.independence_rule: A public source may be independent; the searcher's selection and mapping are not automatically independent.
contamination_controls: hash or cite exact artifacts where lawful

tools.name: GPT/OpenAI models
tools.role: Replaceable reasoning, implementation, critique, synthesis, and review lanes.
tools.independence_rule: Independence depends on prior exposure, prompt/evidence isolation, conflicts, and lane separation, not provider branding.

tools.name: Claude or other external reasoners
tools.role: Replaceable independent or adversarial reasoning lanes when isolation criteria are met.
tools.independence_rule: A different provider is not sufficient; exposure, shared artifacts, prompt lineage, and reviewer incentives must be disclosed.
contamination_controls: separate credentials and workspaces where feasible

tools.name: Notion
tools.role: Optional notes, meeting context, and human-facing mirrors.
tools.independence_rule: Notion content has no Project FAR authority until governably committed to GitHub.
contamination_controls: never resolve conflicts in favor of the mirror

tools.name: Linear
tools.role: Optional task and issue workflow mirror.
prohibited: deleting GitHub evidence after task closure
tools.independence_rule: Task completion is not research acceptance or theorem closure.

tools.name: Base44
tools.role: Prototype interfaces and applications against versioned Project FAR contracts.
tools.independence_rule: A working prototype is implementation evidence, not theory or utility evidence.

tools.name: Floot
tools.role: Prototype application delivery and user-interface experiments where available.
tools.independence_rule: Platform success does not validate contracts or market demand.

tools.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
tools.role: Build replaceable agent workflows around governed FAR tools and evidence.
tools.independence_rule: Agent separation is evidential only when state, tools, prompts, and exposure are actually isolated.

tools.name: ChatGPT Apps/MCP
tools.role: Transport versioned FAR tools, resources, and generated assurance views to clients.
tools.independence_rule: Client delivery does not change the authority of underlying evidence.
